governing_goal: Make native ChatGPT sessions proactively and independently route every selected-context request to the appropriate UAOS execution depth without requiring the user to classify the task, while keeping Custom Instructions bootstrap-only and preserving the explicit boundary that native ChatGPT is not a repository-controlled non-bypassable runtime.
observed_gap: Production session policy made lightweight problem detection always-on but lacked an equally explicit every-turn execution-depth routing responsibility for non-problem research/design/decision work.

The production ChatGPT Custom Instructions pointer activated cognition for problems/corrections/knowledge gaps but did not explicitly assign independent execution-depth assessment to the acting session on every request.

DeepTaskSignals and assess_deep_task_requirement already supported semantic non-explicit escalation, so the missing layer was host/session invocation responsibility rather than a new DeepTask state machine.

external_method_evidence: OpenAI Help Center: Custom Instructions are direct guidance applied across chats, supporting a compact persistent bootstrap pointer rather than a duplicated policy authority.
OpenAI Help Center: Memory is relevance-selected rather than a guaranteed every-detail/every-response rule carrier, so Memory alone is not a deterministic bootstrap substitute.
Existing UAOS architecture principle: policy ownership remains singular; session/host surfaces activate and report canonical cognition rather than redefining it.
implemented_changes: config/SESSION_INTERACTION_POLICY.json policy 2.2.0 now contains always_on_execution_depth_sentinel for every selected-context turn, separate from problem detection.

The sentinel assigns task-depth classification to the selected Agent/session, treats explicit user depth language as a mandatory force signal rather than the only trigger, keeps ordinary work lightweight, and re-evaluates when new evidence changes the depth profile.

docs/integration/CHATGPT_CUSTOM_INSTRUCTIONS.md now carries one compact bootstrap-only non-authoritative pointer that assigns self-classification responsibility without copying the DeepTask evidence profile.
The canonical Custom Instructions pointer is mechanically constrained to <=1500 characters so one version works across current ChatGPT plan limits rather than maintaining drifting tier variants.

HOST_PROFILES.json, CURRENT_SYSTEM.json and AGENTS.md now project the same behavioral self-classification responsibility while explicitly retaining the native ChatGPT no-verified-pre-send/pre-tool/non-bypassable-signal-injector boundary.

Regression coverage includes CURRENT_AGENT dogfood, depth-miss recovery/reclassification, bootstrap-only authority invariants, no-op workflow-clock preservation, and the Custom Instructions character budget.
